annotations.title: Get Compiler Explorer short URL info

description: Retrieve source and compiler config from a CE short URL. Compiler entries are returned in the `compile` tool's shape ({compiler, options, libraries:[{id, version}]}). Multi-pane shortlinks (executors, conformance views, CMake trees, per-compiler filters/tools) are flattened — only the basic compile inputs survive.

id.description: Short link ID or full URL (e.g. "G38YP7eW4" or "https://godbolt.org/z/G38YP7eW4")

name: get_shortlink_info
